name: Daniel Bowen
source:
Favorite tea: Assam. 

A young man whose every manner and demeanor exude true nobility. Because he treats everyone with kindness, he has many admirers. He is the heir to Viscount Bowen, though rumors suggest the family’s internal affairs are in a dire state. He is always cheerful, but occasionally appears terribly exhausted. He prefers his tea with milk.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/tea/teaparty.htm]official website[/url]]
